name: To My Darling: Rewritten
source:
Make way for a true main character! Fujimoto-Beausoleil Kin is a junior high school girl with one thing on her mind — LOVE! This Valentine's Day, she hopes to confess to the boy of her dreams! But she can't do it alone. She needs help from you, the reader, to make the correct decisions throughout her day and lead her to a happy end. 

[From [url=https://ixkyu.itch.io/rewritten]itch.io[/url]]

A retelling of the original "To My Darling", but from Kin's perspective.
